title: Read snapshot text
responsibility: Reads snapshot files in bounded groups while preserving their requested order and failures.

inputs.name: readTreeTexts.tree
inputs.description: A source-tree reader exposing a read(path) method for fetching text. The helper calls it once per requested path and awaits calls in groups of at most 64.

inputs.name: readTreeTexts.paths
inputs.description: Ordered source paths to read. The helper processes at most 64 paths per awaited batch and preserves array order; an empty array causes no reads.

outputs.name: texts
outputs.description: Resolved file text, with one string for each requested path in input order. An empty paths array resolves to an empty array.

errors.name: Read failed
errors.description: A failure from tree.read(path) rejects the helper call, and the helper does not return a partial array.
